changes.summary: Translate train and delivery notification labels and keep notification wording in the selected app language.
Show time until train arrival in the status bar, with confirmed arrival and stale-estimate handling.
Show full train destination names when arrival details are read on separate lines.
Clarify that the distance in train live notifications is the remaining distance.
Read train notification fields by position and keep update times, arrival times, and station names distinct.
Show train arrival time in the header, train identity in the title, and trip status below it.
